paragraphs.source_en: Inabayama Castle was lush with greenery, and the waters of the Nagara River murmured by. The early-summer scenery was just as it had been the year before, but the lord who lived in the castle was no longer the same. Oda Nobunaga had driven Saitō Tatsuoki all the way to Nagashima in Ise, then moved into the castle himself and renamed Inabayama Castle Gifu Castle.

paragraphs.source_en: That day, Nobunaga again went down to the new castle town.
